voice_surface_label: Example State official voter-information voice-answer surface policy
delivery_role_note: Voice search and voice-assistant answers may speed discovery, but they do not become the controlling authority for jurisdiction-specific election rules.
authority_boundary_note: The current official page, signed notice, office-card record, or direct office confirmation remains controlling even when a voice assistant speaks the answer first.
spoken_handoff_policy_note: Spoken answers should route users quickly into current official pages or office/help contacts that make office identity, page purpose, and next-step recovery legible immediately.
screenless_recovery_policy_note: If the answer depends on address, district, office status, temporary hours, or another local fact, the spoken layer should hand off to the current lookup/help lane instead of pretending one sentence safely resolves the case.
current_state_cue_policy_note: Volatile topics should expose current election/cycle cues, special-hours or closure state, and current official routing so spoken compression is easier to recover safely.
office_card_dependency_note: Voice-answer integrity depends on current office-card and local-info state for names, hours, phone, website actions, and directions references.
accessibility_language_policy_note: Voice delivery should not replace other accessibility or language-support paths; when spoken delivery is incomplete or language-limited, route clearly to current human help.
